doc.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997

title: Closing remarks and upcoming Piano Jazz dates
summary: Thanks, and plans for live Piano Jazz shows with Bobby Short.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well we’re very glad you did.
Oh, I’m very glad too, Monk.
Well I’m so pleased that you were able to join us for the Hamilton Jazz Archive.

Well, to Columbia, South Carolina. We’re going to do a live “Piano Jazz” with Bobby Short. We just did one about four weeks ago with Tommy Flanagan in Cleveland. It’s really fun doing a live, well live with an audience. And a lot more concertizing and “Piano Jazz” and more of the same. Schools, a couple of schools, and on and on.
